component.name: Unpack
component.summary: Explore archives and manage portable applications

description.p: Unpack brings archive browsing and transparent portable application installation together in a native Linux desktop application.
Inspect downloaded archives without executing their contents, review installation plans, create application-menu launchers, and manage installed applications without administrator access.
Refined expandable menus and dropdown styling, Open after installation, and direct system launcher icon integration.
Initial development release with archive inspection and managed application installation.
